description: Contract between the Testing/QA agent and the Software Development agent. The report node writes one object shaped like the examples below. 'outcome' tells the Developer agent which kind of problem it has.
attempt: 1 for the first run. Each time the pipeline loops back to the Developer agent the report is written again with attempt + 1, up to 1 + 3 attempts. If the same outcome comes back after the last retry, the run ends with status needs_human_review.

outcome_values.blocked: Project could not install or boot. No tests were written or run. Fix setup_errors.
outcome_values.execution_failed: Tests were written but the test run itself crashed (e.g. database unreachable). Not a code fault in the tests.
outcome_values.tests_failed: Tests ran and some failed. Fix the code behind each entry in faults.
outcome_values.tests_passed: Tests ran and all passed. Nothing to fix. Read skipped_tests: a skipped test did not check anything.

field_notes.summary.skipped: Tests that chose not to run, for example a form flow whose generated data the form rejected. They count in total, never in passed, and are never faults.
field_notes.skipped_tests: One entry per skipped test with the reason it gave. Empty when nothing was skipped.
field_notes.faults[].confidence: high: an assertion failed, or the error passed through the project's own code. low: the error was raised while the generated test was building its own objects with no frame in the project's code, or the generated test module failed to load. A low-confidence fault is kept because it can still be real, but check the test setup before changing project code.
field_notes.faults[].confidence_note: Why the confidence is low. Empty when confidence is high.
field_notes.production: Present only when the tests passed. verdict is ready, ready_with_warnings or not_ready. Each finding has an id, a severity (high blocks a release, medium and low warn), a category, a message and a location. Secret values are never copied into the report: only the kind, the file and the line. entrypoint is the module a web server starts, such as crud_project.wsgi.
field_notes.production.artifacts: Deployment files written to reports/<project>_deployment/. They are generated from the project and checked statically (see artifact_checks); they are never built. Secret values are never copied into them.
field_notes.faults[].affected_tests: Failures that share one cause are reported as one fault. This lists every test that failed because of it. Empty for a fault that belongs to one test. category missing_migrations means a table the project's models need is never created, because its migrations are missing.
